NP Presspad 1.3.10 — Companion plugin security fixes

**This release needs a companion plugin update.** Update it on each of your sites: WordPress will offer it under Plugins, or click "Check for updates" under NP Presspad Companion to fetch it straight away. The app won't remind you about this one, because it only flags a plugin that's a whole minor version behind.

## Companion plugin

- **Scratchpads can no longer be read without logging in.** A scratchpad marked as published could be read by anyone through your site's REST API, logged in or not. The app has always saved scratchpads as private, so this only affected scratchpads published some other way. Reading any scratchpad now needs an account that can edit posts, which is the kind the app already uses.
- **A post's linked scratchpad is no longer public.** Your site's public post data included the ID of each post's linked scratchpad: just the number, never its contents. Now only logged-in editors can see it.
- **The plugin's built-in updater is up to date** (version 5.6 → 5.7). Updates arrive exactly as before.

The app itself is unchanged.
